title: Applying for APL Ration Card in Sabarkantha, Gujarat
facts: In Sabarkantha, APL (Above Poverty Line) ration cards are issued by the local Mamlatdar or District Supply Office.
APL cards are for families not covered under BPL or AAY.
process: 1. Visit the Jan Seva Kendra or the Mamlatdar office in Sabarkantha.
2. Fill out Form No. 2 for a new ration card.
3. Attach proof of residence and identity.
4. A Talati or designated officer will verify the application.
required_documents: Aadhaar cards of all family members
Residential proof (electricity bill, property tax receipt)
Income certificate (optional for APL, but helpful for verification)
fees: Nominal fee of Rs. 20 to Rs. 50 at Jan Seva Kendra.

source.name: Gujarat Food, Civil Supplies & Consumer Affairs Department
